content.name: All Ships with Filters
content.author: Chem O`Dun
content.description: Adds an [b]All Ships[/b] tab to the [b]Property Owned[/b] menu in the map. The tab shows all owned ships in three sections: [b]Fleets[/b], [b]Stations with Assigned Ships[/b] (expanded to show only the subordinate ships, without module or construction rows), and [b]Unassigned Ships[/b]. Supports filtering by ship type, size, sector, dock status, default behaviour, current order, and failed orders.

text.name: All Ships with Filters
text.description: Adds an All Ships tab to the Property Owned map menu. Shows all owned ships: fleets, ships assigned to stations, and unassigned ships. Supports multi-dimensional filtering.
